Introducing The Heritage Edit by Fashionably Pernia, shot in beautiful Bikaner with Bollywood’s icon of retro glamour. 

Featuring Tara Sutaria, the edit brings together exquisite couture, intricate embroidery, rich textiles and statement silhouettes styled as modern heirlooms. 

A celebration of heritage, craftsmanship and the designers shaping Indian fashion today.
